design: Exploratory follow-up after primary study; frozen before receipt calls
reason: All primary finite-sample intervals were unresolved. Test explicit preference reporting as an additional measurement channel.
scope: Repeated extraction from12 unique synthetic preference prompts, not human feedback or independent customer decisions
selection: First40 lexical calibration IDs per domain/class and80 fieldIDs perdomain/cohort; fixed independent of correctness/outcome
primary_endpoint: Number of known-synthetic-contrast decisions resolved by attribute-only receipt channel vs same-budget action-only channel; also report incorrect resolutions, widths, report accuracy and all failures
confidence: 96% marginal perprimary interval conditional on channel model; no simultaneous/invoice/human claim
no_adaptation: No request replacement or prompt changes based on results; no retries
